facts.text: Park Hyatt Kyoto sits along the cobblestones of Ninenzaka in Higashiyama.
facts.excerpt: Nestled along the storied cobblestones of Ninenzaka in Higashiyama, Park Hyatt Kyoto is a luxury guesthouse

facts.text: The hotel is located within Kyoto's largest preserved traditional building district.

facts.text: The hotel is set on historic temple grounds with views of Yasaka Pagoda and the machiya townscape.

facts.text: The rooms feature interiors crafted from fragrant tamo wood and contemporary art by local artists.

facts.text: The hotel was built as a partnership of the Pritzker, Takenaka and Kyoyamato families, with Tony Chi as interior designer.
facts.excerpt: The structure is a partnership of the Pritzker, Takenaka (a 17th-generation construction family responsible for many of Japan's temples), and Kyoyamato families, with Tony Chi as interior designer.

facts.text: The hotel is stacked on a hill with a maze of hallways, corridors and garden paths.
